summary: Through road with no parked cars and homes 9 to 20 m from the kerb.
reasons: Marked through road, no kerbside parking
Homes 9-21 m back along the whole kerb
No verge or pull-off outside the lane

best_section.where: north kerb opposite the park, between the 150 m and 200 m marks

drivers.seclusion: Houses and a fenced vacant block back this kerb; nearest dwelling 9 m at 141 m, then about 20 m from 197 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane with a centre line; kerb is tight to the fence with no verge or pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Collector road linking roundabouts, with moving traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs and no cars parked along the kerb in the imagery.

flags: Main road with no parked cars

Gate mapped 15 m from the start, with a way round
sun_shade: Open road; afternoon shade from the trees in the park on the south side.
